## Orientation

Parallel tasks in this wave edit disjoint files. Stay inside your task scope. Install node_modules in your worktree with `npm ci` in `dashboard/web/ui` when you need npm. Do not push.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/web-packaging--dist-in-wheel`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R1: The built wheel contains `dashboard/frontend/dist/index.html`.
R2: The release build runs `npm run build` before it builds the wheel.
R4: With the wheel installed in a clean environment, `GET /` returns the UI index.
R5: The `ci` effort's wheel smoke job asserts R4.
Context: the web dashboard UI is built by `cd dashboard/frontend && npm ci && npm run build` into `dashboard/frontend/dist` (gitignored by `dashboard/frontend/.gitignore`). The FastAPI app in `dashboard/backend/server/app.py` serves `DIST` (`dashboard/frontend/dist`) at `/` when it exists and otherwise returns the `MISSING_BUILD` message that names `npm run build`. `scripts/wheel_smoke.py [--wheel PATH]` builds a wheel from `git archive HEAD` in a temp dir with `uv build --wheel`, installs it into a new venv and runs checks from outside the checkout (each prints `<name>: pass|fail`); the CI `wheel` job runs `python3 scripts/wheel_smoke.py` (a frozen test pins that exact run line). `pyproject.toml` lists the packages and package-data; setuptools builds the wheel and needs no Node. The repo has no release workflow; the CI `wheel` job is the build. `ci.yml` jobs: checks, test-canon, test-tuner, test-orchestra, types, web, wheel; a test requires `setup-uv` on Python 3.10 with `enable-cache: true` in every job that uses uv, and every job has `timeout-minutes`. Biome lint must stay at zero findings (`npm run lint` in dashboard/frontend). The seeded-store fixtures in `tests/conftest.py` are reusable from Python tests.

## Approach

(1) `pyproject.toml`: add `dashboard = ["frontend/dist/**/*"]` to `[tool.setuptools.package-data]` so the wheel ships `dashboard/frontend/dist/**` (verify with a real `uv build --wheel` on a copy that has a fake `dist/index.html`; the path of `dist` inside the package must equal the source layout: `app.py` resolves `DIST` as `parents[2]/frontend/dist`). (2) `scripts/wheel_smoke.py`: add `--dist PATH` (default `<checkout>/dashboard/frontend/dist`); before `uv build --wheel`, copy that directory into `<temp source>/dashboard/frontend/dist`; when building (no `--wheel`) and `PATH/index.html` is missing, exit 1 with a message that names `npm run build` in `dashboard/frontend`. Add the check `GET /`: from the temp work dir, start the installed server (`python -m dashboard.backend.server` with the temp git repo as the store, a free port, loopback), wait until it answers, `GET /`, require HTTP 200 and the same bytes as the index in the wheel (`dashboard/frontend/dist/index.html` inside the venv's site-packages), print `GET /: pass|fail`, and always terminate the server. A given `--wheel` without dist makes `GET /` fail. Keep every existing check, the exit-code rule, and the `python3 scripts/wheel_smoke.py` command string. (3) `ci.yml` `wheel` job: add `actions/setup-node@v4` (node 22, npm cache on `dashboard/frontend/package-lock.json`), `npm ci` and `npm run build` (working-directory `dashboard/frontend`) before the `python3 scripts/wheel_smoke.py` step; keep the `setup-uv` step and `timeout-minutes` (raise to 20 if needed), no `continue-on-error`. (4) Update `tests/test_wheel_smoke.py` so its wheel builds pass a fake `--dist` directory (tmp path with an `index.html`) and the assertions stay; update README.md's Wheel check section to say the check needs `npm run build` first. Run `uv run pytest tests/test_wheel_smoke.py tests/test_ci_workflow.py tests/dashboard/test_web_packaging.py -q -n 4`, `uvx ruff@0.13.1 check .`, `uv run basedpyright`.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R1: The built wheel contains `dashboard/frontend/dist/index.html`.
R2: The release build runs `npm run build` before it builds the wheel.
R4: With the wheel installed in a clean environment, `GET /` returns the UI index.
R5: The `ci` effort's wheel smoke job asserts R4.

### Design / decisions (quote)

- `dist` is not committed.
- Python development works without Node.

- `ci:wheel-smoke` exists and installs the wheel in a clean environment.
- The path of `dist` inside the package is the same in the source tree and in the wheel.

- `dist-packaging`: CI builds dist and package data ships it

- `wheel-smoke-ownership`: ci:wheel-smoke stays in the ci effort and web-packaging depends on it

### Frozen oracle (do not edit)

Files in acceptance oracle_hashes are frozen. Do not edit them:
- ['tests/dashboard/test_web_packaging.py']
An oracle hash or test-id change is a signed amendment in `.tuner/manifest.json`. orchestra verify verdict accepts or rejects it. A non-zero exit means the acceptance is not done.
